import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    a0,a1,a2,a3,k,b,d = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6]
    return a0 + a1*T + a2/T + a3*np.exp(-k*T**1.5) + b*eps*np.exp(-d*eps)/T
